name: Autosomal Recessive Congenital Ichthyosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for ARCI

criteria.description: Presence of generalized scaly erythroderma at birth
Lamellar or plate-like scaling of the skin persisting beyond neonatal period
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in ARCI-associated genes (e.g., TGM1, ALOX12B, NIPAL4)
Consanguinity or family history of similar skin disorder
Exclusion of other ichthyosis subtypes by clinical and genetic evaluation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital generalized scaling with persistent lamellar scaling plus identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in ARCI-associated genes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is critical for confirmation due to phenotypic overlap with other ichthyoses.

pathognomonic.notes: Thick, plate-like scales covering most of the body
Redness and scaling present at birth
Eyelid eversion due to skin tightness

common.notes: Thickening of skin on palms and soles
Reduced sweating leading to heat intolerance
Hair thinning or scaling on scalp

searchTerms: nasal passage obstruction due to flaking skin

occasional.notes: Due to impaired skin barrier and fluid loss
Bacterial or fungal infections due to skin barrier defects
Eversion of lips due to tight skin
Due to skin tightness limiting mobility

rare.notes: Reported in some cases possibly related to skin involvement
Secondary to chronic ectropion and exposure
Due to chronic illness and nutritional issues

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests unless secondary infection present
imaging: Not routinely required; joint imaging if contractures suspected
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in genes such as TGM1, ALOX12B, NIPAL4, CYP4F22
other: Skin biopsy showing hyperkeratosis with absent or reduced granular layer

distinguishingFeatures: Often considered a subtype of ARCI but may have distinct genetic causes
More uniform thick scaling without erythroderma at birth
Milder scaling, typically sparing flexural areas
Severe neonatal presentation with thick armor-like plates

redFlags: Severe dehydration and electrolyte imbalance in neonatal period
references: Rajpopat S, Moss C, Mellerio J, et al. Clinical and molecular characterization of autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis: a comprehensive review. Br J Dermatol. 2011;165(3):565-572.
Orphanet: Autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis. Orphanet Report Series. 2023.
